ch04/girl_scouts_halloween_party_dc_1938.title: Cabinet Lady directs cutting of pumpkin at Girl Scouts Halloween party. Washington, D.C., Oct. 29. Washington Girl Scouts celebrated the opening of National Girls Scout week today at a Halloween party at the National Girls Scout Little House. Mrs. Henry A. Wallace, wife of the Secretary of Agriculture who was guest of honor, is pictured showing Scout Ridgely Chapline the proper way to cut out a pumpkin, 10/29/38
